title: Open-complement cohomological-dimension condition
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $V,T$ be schemes
[def-pc-scheme], and let $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ be an open immersion
[def-weil-open-immersion] which is quasi-compact
[def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$.
Use the small etale sites $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ and $T_{\mathrm{et}}$
[def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and the categories of sheaves of modules over
the constant coefficient ring $A$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For such
a sheaf $M$ on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, $R^qj_*M$ denotes its higher direct
image on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].
Constructible sheaves have the meaning of the sheaf clause of
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

Say that $(V,T)$ satisfies the *open-complement condition at $A$ with
constant $c$* if both of the following hold:

1. For every sheaf $M$ of $A$-modules on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ and every
integer $q>c$, one has $R^qj_*M=0$.
2. For every constructible sheaf $F$ of $A$-modules on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$
and every integer $q$, the sheaf $R^qj_*F$ is constructible on
$T_{\mathrm{et}}$.

Thus the condition is a predicate depending on the specified coefficient
ring $A$, the open immersion $j$, and the nonnegative bound $c$.

Let $A$ be a finite ring, let $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ be a
quasi-compact open immersion,

satisfies the *open-complement condition with constant $c$* if

$$

$R^qj_*$ carries constructible
sheaves to constructible sheaves in
